bibl.title: Neither Byzantine nor Islamic? The duke of the Thebaid and the formation of the Umayyad state
bibl.seg: Marie Legendre, Neither Byzantine nor Islamic? The duke of the Thebaid and the formation of the Umayyad State.
bibl.note: The progressive redistribution of the responsibilities of the duke of the Thebaid to new offices developed within the Islamic state shows how the Byzantine system contributed to the formation of Islamic administration, casting light on a pre-Islamic heritage which is often neglected in the narrative.
